name: Solvend
tagline: Personalised daily crypto briefings by email, with a chat for questions.
problem: Crypto markets move constantly and following them is overwhelming.
solution: Gemini summarises market trends and news based on interests and portfolio, delivered by email, with an interactive chat drawing on Solana APIs.
demo_moment: Team-described: receive a briefing and ask a follow-up.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Creative Solana MCP” among 122 submissions.

lessons: A daily digest beats another dashboard.
